nodes.label: Recurring events (recurrenceSeriesId)
nodes.rationale: Each occurrence materialized as an independent event to reuse tags, admin assignments, reminders, range queries and FOCUS/MANDATORY logic; series capped at 2 years / 731 occurrences to prevent unbounded record creation

nodes.label: AppRestrictionService
nodes.rationale: Kills configured executables every 5s during Focus; kept separate from input blocking because cycles and risks differ; also centralizes blocked-website CRUD with domain normalization

nodes.label: tools/blockScreen.ps1 (user32 BlockInput)
nodes.rationale: BlockInput(false) must always run (try/finally) and be gated by win32; currently waits fixed 20s, decoupled from window duration (pending fix)

nodes.label: /api/browser-blocking-policy and /api/blocked-websites
nodes.rationale: Policy endpoint exposes only effective Focus boolean and domains; CORS widened to chrome-extension://*

nodes.label: GMO Chrome/Edge MV3 browser extension
nodes.rationale: Keeps last rules when GMO is unreachable to avoid temporary opening; local unpacked extension, a productivity barrier not admin control

nodes.label: Effective Focus mode (manual toggle or FOCUS calendar event)
nodes.norm_label: effective focus mode (manual toggle or focus calendar event)

nodes.label: Extra blocking layer (Focus break lock)
nodes.rationale: Visual lock screen informs; native BlockInput prevents bypassing via other windows; it is a local wellbeing/productivity restriction, not an OS security control

nodes.label: start-block IPC channel (preload security boundary)
nodes.rationale: preload.js exposes only startBlock via contextBridge so the renderer never gets full ipcRenderer or Node access

nodes.label: webNavigation tab-based blocking layer
nodes.rationale: Network rules miss PWA service-worker navigations (x.com), SPA route changes and already-open tabs; host match by exact or .domain suffix so box.com is not confused with x.com

nodes.label: GMO Architecture (React 19 + Electron 39 + Spring Boot 3.5 + MySQL)
nodes.norm_label: gmo architecture (react 19 + electron 39 + spring boot 3.5 + mysql)

nodes.label: Dependency and Dependabot alert policy
nodes.rationale: Spring Boot kept on 3.x to avoid major migration; verification done locally via npm audit and Maven against exact lockfiles

nodes.label: Notes API (/notes, owner_id scoped)
nodes.rationale: Notes persisted in DB not localStorage; backend always filters by authenticated user id so foreign note IDs cannot be read or modified

nodes.label: Migration from Create React App to Vite
nodes.norm_label: migration from create react app to vite
nodes.rationale: react-scripts@5 is obsolete and pulled many unfixable transitive vulnerability alerts; Vite only replaces the dev server/bundler, base './' keeps file:// compatibility for Electron

nodes.label: Vite reversion procedure
nodes.rationale: Not recommended because it reintroduces the vulnerable, unmaintained dependency chain
